title: Eagle Band members and Lorenzo Starr's songs
summary: He names Eagle Band members, including Bob Lyons and Frankie Dusen, and the bawdy guitarist-singer Lorenzo Starr.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Well, if I can recall at that time, I can call some of the guys, I think. Bob Lyne, you know, Bob Lyne was an Eagle Band all these days, most of all these days. Frankie Deuce and they had Chiff on trumpet. I think they had Lil' Warnick on the clarinet. And Danny Lewis on. No, it wasn't Danny Lewis. Danny Lewis came in the Eagle Band later on after Bob Lyne left. Now, who was the drummer? I can't recall. I don't know if it was Hennerzine or Hennerzine. I don't know, I can't recall who was the drummer. Guitar?
Well, they always had, that's a guy's name, had a bulldozer cigarette his mouth. He always had some old nasty joke he was telling you. I know that, yes.
You know who I'm speaking about, what's his name?
Lorenzo Starr, yeah, Lorenzo Starr. Yeah, he was the band, yeah. And what would he sing?
Oh, man, I don't want to be singing songs that he sang, man.
Wow. What kind of songs were they?
Well, he sang, well, later on, it was, you know, I don't know. I don't know.
I don't know. I don't know.
Well, he sang, well, later on they published a tune called Mama's Baby Boy.
Yeah, but he had a special version.
Yeah, he had a special version, but I don't want to go through that.
Yeah, but I mean that gives me the idea of what he said. Those kind of numbers, aren't they?
Yeah, those kind of numbers, yeah.
